en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a vaulted outdoor arcade lined with sculptures on pedestals. The statues appear to be expressive bronze or stone figures placed along a wooden floor under repeated arches; benches line the wall on the left. At the far end of the colonnade there is an opening to a courtyard with cobblestones and a low wall. The overall style and tone suggest an early‑20th‑century art postcard. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
